method: Historical 2017Q3 V1.8 discovery replay using current model/search. No post-cutoff selected-stock outcomes are opened before run lock.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
Only evidence provably public by 2017-09-30 is frozen.
The holdout is independent of V1.8 rule design at the repository level, but historical replay remains diagnostic rather than a clean forward alpha trial.
